text.title: 关门后留下的椅子
text.situation:
周四关门后，三把椅子仍留在员工桌旁。米娜把没完成的排班表放在中间。等级关系很简单：她管理店铺，杰伊和努尔向她汇报。在这个安排里，他们的职位低于她，但也知道她不知道的事情。杰伊说，反复无偿加班会压榨员工，并不能解决机器问题。努尔同意，避免剥削与维持营业同样重要。他们列出其他利益相关者：等待的顾客、供应商和房屋所有人。计划必须与实际的时间和钱相符。米娜把一项原定取件改到下周，写下谁打电话。桌面清空后，三人一起从前门离开。

周四——商定的调整
一项原定取件改到下周，杰伊联系顾客。
在安排好的付薪工作时间内处理积压维修。
努尔确认周六柜台时间。
下一版排班确定前，米娜联系维修师傅和供应商。

paragraphs.en: On Thursday, the three chairs stayed beside the staff table after closing. Mina placed the unfinished rota in the middle. The hierarchy was simple: she managed the shop, and Jay and Noor reported to her. Their roles were subordinate to hers in that arrangement, but they knew things she did not. Jay said that repeated unpaid extra work would exploit the staff rather than solve the machine problem. Noor agreed that avoiding exploitation mattered as much as keeping the door open. They listed the other stakeholders: waiting customers, the supplier and the owner of the building. A plan had to be aligned with the time and money they actually had. Mina moved one scheduled collection to the following week and wrote down who would make the call. When the table was clear, they went out through the front door together.

paragraphs.en:
THURSDAY — AGREED CHANGES
Move one scheduled collection to next week; Jay will call the customer.
Use paid, scheduled time for the repair backlog.
Noor will confirm Saturday counter hours.
Mina will speak to the repairer and supplier before the next rota is finalised.

S08.Q17.P01.cue: 说说小店的职位和级别。
acceptableAnswers: 小店有简单的等级体系。 在小店等级安排中，杰伊的职位低于米娜。

S08.Q17.P02.cue: 说明对不公平工作的担忧。
acceptableAnswers: 反复无偿额外工作会压榨员工。 他们希望避免剥削员工。

S08.Q17.P03.cue: 说明计划应考虑哪些人和实际限制。
acceptableAnswers: 等待的顾客是小店计划的利益相关者。 计划必须与可用的时间和金钱相一致。

S08.Q17.T01.cue: 项目计划要与商定目标一致，怎么说？
acceptableAnswers: 计划需要与我们的目标一致。
